subject.title: perf(infra): skip tsdown cleanup when CI=true

question: Should CI be allowed to skip all OpenClaw tsdown wrapper cleanup, or should this performance work preserve stale-output cleanup and narrow the skip to a proven-safe slow helper?
rationale: The diff changes a CI artifact safety boundary, and green checks plus timing logs do not settle whether restored stale outputs can safely remain when tsdown runs with `--no-clean`.

options.title: Preserve stale-output cleanup
options.body: Keep CI cleanup for restored output roots and narrow any performance optimization to a measured slow helper with regression coverage.

options.title: Accept restored-cache risk
options.body: A build owner can intentionally accept the broad skip, but the PR should document that decision and include proof across restored-cache artifact workflows.

options.title: Pause the broad skip
options.body: Leave this PR open or close it in favor of a narrower measured build-script change if the slow cleanup step cannot be isolated.

recommendation.title: Preserve stale-output cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep CI cleanup for restored output roots and narrow any performance optimization to a measured slow helper with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original cleanup path and recently changed the artifact Testbox workflow involved in this CI build boundary.
